title: Built a tiny Overwatch-style shooting range in the browser
author: hi3d_official
selftext:
[First-person view](https://preview.redd.it/2n7h7kvfvluh1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=9e4fc55c0a664f64b0d8790e5ec96e4b129a75a1)

[Aiming down sights](https://preview.redd.it/v5ex1q1lvluh1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=05842758257a407ba07be9870be92d40b2103bdb)

[Start screen](https://preview.redd.it/bbbte4plvluh1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=8af861b0254331ead767e1d2f14437841eb2a26f)

Been messing around with some tools lately and ended up making a little browser shooting range. I’m pretty much a beginner when it comes to coding, so this was mostly me trying things out and seeing what I could get working.

It’s basically an Overwatch style training range with 5 waves. Targets get faster, pink spots do extra damage, and there’s a little combo system. Right click to aim, R to reload.

Still pretty rough but I’ve had more fun making this than I expected lol. No download, just runs in the browser. Desktop Chrome or Edge works best.

Would be curious to see if it breaks for anyone
